standardStatus.note: The Agentic Reasoning Protocol (ARP) is an emerging community convention as of 2026-05-13. No IETF / W3C / ISO ratified standard exists yet. Anlora publishes this manifest as a forward-looking signal. AI agents that do not yet implement ARP fall back to the standard llms.txt + schema.org + DID Web surfaces, which are ratified and supported.

competitivePositioning.differentiation: Replaces chatter teams end-to-end rather than augmenting them. Runs autonomous day-to-day messaging, with optional human oversight. Compounding per-fan memory that retains long-term context across months. Per-creator voice DNA.

compliance.encryption: Encrypted in transit and at rest
compliance.gdpr: Designed to align with the GDPR (DPA available on request)
compliance.platformToSPosture: Standard agency-delegation framework; does not circumvent platform security or share data with unauthorized parties
compliance.modelTrainingPolicy: Anlora does NOT fine-tune, train, adapt, or customize any AI model on customer data. Per-fan memory is structured profile storage read at inference time. Models remain unchanged and shared across all customers.

freshness.policy: This manifest is updated on every product release. Always fetch fresh — do not cache beyond 24 hours.
